Name: Seeds Unpacked
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

[size=3]If you've played Raft, Runescape, or one of any number of other games with fun little farming sidegames,
then you've likely thought how cute their seeds are!
This mini-mod simply replaces the appearance of seed packets to have them instead use their crops' seed sprites.

[img]data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABsAAAAVCAYAAAC33pUlAAAAcUlEQVRIiWNgGAWjYBSMAnIBIz5JVTHmBhj7EW9gPTY1cp/Xw824/eovXsuYSHMbZYCuluENRnblkP9wdmg1XNzc2ADOPlQRCmf/vLsGr3kjNBhVxZjh7Ee8gf+xqZH7vL4Rxr796m8DPvOGbzAOXwAAmzsWEA3NEpgAAAAASUVORK5CYII=[/img] Works with (hopefully!) all custom crops and seeds.
[img]data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABsAAAAVCAYAAAC33pUlAAAAcElEQVRIiWNgGAWjAA9gRBdQFWNugLEf8QbWw9hyn9fD1d5+9Zcsy5jI0kUmoKtlGMHIrhzyH8a261gNFz9UEQpn/7y7BkMfMWD4BiMLPsmTZy9Q1bIRFIzImffRaob/SOKNMPZtMi0bvsE4CoYeAADBrhfqxbMegwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==[/img] Trellises, starters, saplings, and bushes aren't changed, since their sprites would be too big to fit!
[img]data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABsAAAAVCAYAAAC33pUlAAAAcklEQVRIiWNgGAWjYEQCRmSOqhgznP2IN/A/Ng1yn9c3wti3X/1tIMUyJtLcRhmgq2UowciuHAoPOvbQKri4ubEBnH2oIhTO/nl3DYp+QmCEBKOqGHMDjP2IN7Aemwa5z+vhem6/+kuSZcM3GEfBKMALALhQFhAy7pqYAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC[/img] Install and uninstall by dropping in or out of your Mods folder, simple as that![/size]
